behavior_contract.load_bearing_success_condition: coverage is complete, dimensions/types/invariants are consistent, and independently generated acceptance checks cover each material graph edge
behavior_contract.load_bearing_verification_route: freeze graph before final builder validation; check lineage coverage, intermediate invariants and structurally independent consequences

independent_static_findings.runtime_fact: For every declared invariant the compiler validates only that the row is a mapping and that kind and statement are nonempty strings, then copies those strings into graph_rows. No invariant predicate is evaluated against inputs, operator semantics, outputs, or any independent oracle.
independent_static_findings.candidate_conflict: The ceiling theorem states that declared invariants are preserved and concludes universal success on the frozen behavior relation.
independent_static_findings.contract_conflict: The behavior success condition requires invariants to be consistent and the verification route requires checking intermediate invariants.
independent_static_findings.deduction: A compiler that merely records an invariant statement cannot universally certify that the invariant holds. Therefore the claimed universal soundness/ceiling conclusion does not follow from the exact runtime.

independent_static_findings.runtime_fact: For each rule the compiler emits the same six literal acceptance-check labels. It does not synthesize, execute, or bind an independently generated consequence for any material edge.
independent_static_findings.candidate_conflict: The candidate treats graph materialization plus these structural checks as universal success.
independent_static_findings.contract_conflict: The behavior contract requires independently generated acceptance checks for each material edge and explicitly rejects builder-derived checks that merely recompute the same graph.
independent_static_findings.deduction: Static check names emitted by the builder are not evidence of structural independence. The exact runtime therefore does not implement the full behavior relation it is claimed to universally ceiling.

independent_static_findings.runtime_fact: The runtime validates operator only as a nonempty string token. It has no operator semantic-signature object and performs no semantic relation check connecting operator, input contracts, output contract, or invariants.
independent_static_findings.source_conflict: The runtime module docstring says unknown operator identity is acceptable because its semantic signature is part of the normalized rule input, while the executable compile_graph contract contains no such signature field.
independent_static_findings.deduction: The proof may treat semantic normalization as upstream, but the claimed machine-checked frozen boundary does not bind the purported semantic signature. A malformed or semantically incompatible operator token can therefore pass the graph compiler whenever metadata shape checks pass.

constructive_witness.purpose: Exhibit an input shape accepted by the exact runtime's structural guards while the load-bearing invariant and independent-acceptance obligations remain unproved.
static_path_proof: x is admitted as a unique typed input.
REQ_POSITIVE_OUTPUT is admitted as an applicable supported-source requirement.
R1 becomes ready because x exists.
operator passes because it is only required to be a nonempty token.
output metadata is accepted as nonempty type/dimension.
REQ_POSITIVE_OUTPUT is marked consumed by R1.
the invariant row passes because kind and statement are nonempty strings; its truth is never evaluated.
y is inserted as a derived node, so required_outputs traceability passes.
the compiler therefore has no remaining structural reason to reject this instance even though it has proved neither the declared positivity invariant nor an independent consequence of R1.

minimum_repair_cut: Freeze an executable invariant semantics contract or explicitly narrow the behavior contract so invariant truth is not part of the claimed relation.

Bind operator semantic signatures in machine-readable normalized-rule inputs and validate the signature relation needed by the theorem, or explicitly remove semantic-signature claims from the proof boundary.
Generate and verify edge consequences through an independence mechanism that is not merely a literal checklist emitted by the same builder.
Only then restate and independently verify the universal theorem over the exact repaired runtime and exact behavior relation.
